typed_links.link: The tabernacle instruction panels (25-31) and execution panels (35-39) form a recorded register pairing; panel-level correspondences are evidence for form labels, never boundary authority.

The completed-action compliance colophons at 39:32 (M8-Exod-161), 39:42, and 40:16 are one construction family (the prospective 31:11 counterpart is related but distinct, evidence-only); their shared closing-not-opening treatment is the stated criterion.
The continuation particle at 4:6 (mid-unit, non-boundary) is the controlling precedent for reading 3:15 as continuative in the 3:11-22 merge.
